failure_summary.description: The agent chose a prominent related entity or repeated the clue instead of resolving the full clue, despite existing guidance to use direct evidence and identify the omitted answer.
The answer identified the right place or person but included an unnecessary name element, or used a different conventional form than the expected concise answer.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs the agent to match the full clue, complete fragmentary expressions, return the requested place attribute, and use a minimal unambiguous name form. These failures reflect not following those rules rather than a missing generalizable rule, so adding more text would duplicate existing guidance.
